title: anvil projects registry
description: projects.json at the root of an anvil data space: the project registry and global settings.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the data format. Migrated with `anvil migrate`.

archiveAfterDays.description: Days an item stays in its final status before `anvil archive` moves it. Default 60.

id.description: Folder name under projects/. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. `inbox` and `general` are reserved.

prefix.description: Item id prefix, 2 to 4 capital letters. `IN` and `GN` are reserved.

kind.description: Picks the template of starting items.

release.description: `versioned`: items go from done to released with a version. `none`: done is final.

repos.description: Git repositories of the project, as owner/name.
